**F1. Wave-1 parallelism unsafe (A-BLOCKER).** C5 edits types in legal_engine/db_models/campaign-pipeline that C3's test imports → type-resolution race. FIX: serialize C5 → C3; only C4 stays in wave 1.

**F2. No publish button exists (A-BLOCKER).** Only action is "Save & Re-Hash" (`horse-workspace.tsx:914-938`), local `compileLegalPack`, zero fetch. FIX: ADD distinct "Publish to Storefront" button POSTing full payload w/ bearer token; keep Save & Re-Hash for legal-only updates.

**F3. Adapter underspecified (A-BLOCKER).** `ExtractedIntakeData` lacks required payload fields (wholesaleMonthlyNzd semantics differ from costMonthlyNzd; HorseLookupRecord missing damSire/colour/microchip etc.; trainer "Stable, Location" combined string vs split fields; owner name vs entity). FIX: adapter maps from **`horseContext` (SyndicateLegalContext) held in workspace state**, not parser output alone; unmapped required fields = manual-entry validation before publish enabled.
